info.cls_ename: SJSU-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Business Analytics

description.describe_ch: Through the advanced development of information techniques, databases provide an important link for business programming and analysis. Students will learn about database management, database applications, structured programming language, and database contents for business analyses through the introduction of database types, linkages among data, and elementary programming languages such as SQL (Structured Query Language). Students will be able to program using either SAS or R programming language to solve business problems. Students will work on final projects to demonstrate how those computer programming languages can present business solutions.

Students will be able to program using either SAS or R programming language to solve business problems. Students will work on final projects to demonstrate how those computer programming languages can present business solutions.

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
R is a programming language and free software environment primarily designed for statistical computing and graphics. Developed in 1993, it has since become a vital tool for data mining and data analysis. It provides a wide variety of statistical (linear and nonlinear modeling, classical statistical tests, time-series analysis, etc.) and graphical techniques.
Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language known for its readability and versatility. Created in the late 1980s, Python is now widely used for web development, artificial intelligence, scientific computing, and more. Its expansive library ecosystem, such as NumPy for numerical computations and TensorFlow for deep learning, makes it a favorite among many developers.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: 期中考試包含的問題著重於評估你掌握數據分析的能力。評估課程至今所學基本概念的理解與初步應用。
gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: The Midterm Examination will cover the content from Chapters 1-6 of "Statistics for Business  and Economics, 11th" by Anderson, David R., et al. The exam will consist of problems and questions directly based on the material presented in the textbook. The purpose of the exam is to assess your understanding of the concepts and techniques covered in these chapters. The exam will be closed-book, but you will be allowed to bring one sheet of notes (both sides). The Midterm Examination will contribute 50% to your final grade.

During the in-class examination, students will utilize a lab hour to tackle problems presented in the first two lecture hours. This assessment serves as both a practical application of learned concepts and a review session, consolidating understanding and addressing any lingering questions.

Homework assignments, issued approximately 10 times throughout the course, are designed to reinforce and review content from recent lectures. These assignments provide students with an opportunity to delve deeper into the material, ensuring a more profound understanding and enhanced insights.

In the final presentation, groups of 5 to 6 members will collaboratively delve into data analysis from various perspectives. Each member will contribute their unique expertise and understanding, fostering a comprehensive exploration of the dataset at hand. This collective approach ensures a holistic understanding, allowing the group to draw richer insights and make more informed conclusions. Through teamwork, each participant not only learns the nuances of the data but also experiences the value of diverse thought processes in analytical work. This presentation promises to be a culmination of rigorous data exploration and collaborative synergy.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
學期成績記分法
本科目採百分記分法，本科目採等第記分。
出席及缺席
登記為曠課者，曠課一次扣平時成績 5 個百分比分數 。學生請假依本校學生請假辦法辦理，務必要在上課之前，檢附請假理由及文件，線上提出申請。若不在申請期限內完成請假作業者，無充分的理由，經核准不得取消扣分。
課堂互動與參與討論作業
每位學生每週上iLearn 課程討論區，針對當次練習作業進行作答，作答完簽名得分。
作業提交及遲交
每次作業延遲一天則扣分5％。若您能提前通知我，並附上說明和預計完成的時間，我將酌情考量展延繳交作業時間的請求，若理由不充分不會批准請求。用iLearn提交作業，書面資料要使用Microsoft Office/Word、Excel、PowerPoint進行撰寫。
考評及補考
應參加考試之學生，未遵守請假或請假未經核准，而未參加考試者，該科該次考試成績以零分計算。
作弊及抄襲
違反此規則者，該次評核“不計分”或課程“不計分”。如有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，均依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法相關規定處理。
加分及補救措施
如果您發現學期出現困難時，如跟不上學習進度、聽不懂、或作業有問題等，請您儘早與老師聯繫，以便幫助您找到解決方案。
學期預警
當我發現您的學習進度跟不上、可能會妨礙學業成功之疑慮時，我可能會發出預警訊息給您、及您的學習導師。如果您收到預警通知，則您有責任盡快與我聯繫，討論學習上問題，將透過諮詢方式，給予您可能的協助。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Grading Methodology This course uses percentage scoring, and the course uses grading by rank.
Attendance and Absences Those who are registered as absent will have 5 percent deducted from their regular scores for each absence. Students need to apply for leave in accordance with the school's student leave procedures, and must submit an online application before the class, attaching reasons for leave and documents. If leave operations are not completed within the application period without adequate reason, approved deductions cannot be cancelled.
Classroom Interaction and Discussion Assignments Every student is required to answer the practice assignments in the iLearn course discussion area every week. Points are awarded once the assignment is completed and signed.
Assignment Submission and Late Submission For each day an assignment is delayed, 5% will be deducted. If you can notify me in advance, attach an explanation and the estimated completion time, I will consider requests to extend the assignment submission time. Insufficient reasons will not be approved. Assignments are submitted via iLearn. Written materials should be prepared using Microsoft Office/Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
Examination and Make-up Exams Students who should take the exams but do not comply with the leave procedures or whose leave is not approved will receive a score of zero for that exam.
Cheating and Plagiarism Violation of this rule will result in "no score" for the assessment or "no score" for the course. If there are incidents of taking exams on behalf of others, both parties involved in the deception will be dealt with according to the relevant provisions of the Feng Chia University student rewards and punishment procedures.
Extra Credit and Remedial Measures If you find yourself having difficulties during the semester, such as being unable to keep up with the learning progress, not understanding, or having problems with assignments, please contact the teacher as early as possible to help you find a solution.
Semester Warning When I notice that your learning progress is not keeping up and there is a concern that it may hinder your academic success, I may send a warning message to you and your academic advisor. If you receive a warning notification, you are responsible for contacting me as soon as possible to discuss learning problems. Through consultation, possible assistance will be given to you.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
本課堂強調多元包容、專業和禮貌。課堂行為應及時、專業、做好準備、有禮貌，並尊重所有人。
本課堂規範包括出席、準時、尊重他人、專心聆聽、適當使用電子設備等。
網路行為也需同樣尊重，且需要保持良好的溝通和正確的信件格式，
保持開放態度，尊重多元意見，以及適當表達自己的觀點。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Classroom Protocol and Expected Behavior   

Maintain respectful and considerate interaction in and out of the classroom.
Arrive on time and stay for the duration of class.
Avoid distracting behaviors (talking, sleeping, etc.), and minimize use of devices.
Listen attentively, participate actively, and speak clearly when presenting.
Keep mobile devices silent and put away, and do not wear earphones.
Dress appropriately and maintain cleanliness.
Diversity and Inclusion

Respect and value the diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives of all students.
Foster a respectful and inclusive environment in the classroom.
Course Communication and Netiquette Guidelines

Use o365 mailbox for course-related communication, and be polite and clear in all interactions.
Maintain respectful and considerate behavior online, similar to in-person classroom etiquette.
Participate actively in online activities, and respect others' participation and opinions.
Keep written communication clear, concise, and focused.
Review and proofread all written content before posting.
Avoid excessive use of emojis and caps, slang, and inappropriate content.
Student Responsibilities

Keep your contact information updated in the MyFCU personal information form.
Confirm activation of your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID password.
Understand and comply with the course syllabus, manage your study time well, and regularly check updates.
Adhere to academic integrity, participate actively, and use library resources and copyrighted textbooks responsibly.
Provide feedback through mid-term and final course evaluations.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
Every moment in class is precious, and active participation is key to maximizing its value. Here are two pivotal tips for enhancing your learning:

Note-taking: Rather than merely copying, jotting down lectures helps process information, reinforcing understanding. These notes are also beneficial for exam revisions.

Resource Utilization: Take advantage of our provided resources like online courses and learning centers. They are there to help clarify complex topics and offer additional study techniques.

Embrace learning wholeheartedly, and always seek assistance when needed. Together, let's make this journey enriching.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1.  確保正確引用資料，不作弊偷看別人的答案或使用禁止的資源。
  2.  尊重別人觀點，禮貌地提出意見。
  3.  不抄襲他人的成果。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. Ensure accurate citation of sources, do not cheat by peeking at others' answers or use prohibited resources.
2. Respect others' views, and politely voice your opinions.
3. Do not plagiarize the work of others.
4. Ensure the accuracy of information, avoiding the use of unverified sources.
5. Maintain an open and honest attitude in discussions, avoiding misleading others.

If you receive a warning notification, you are responsible for contacting me as soon as possible to discuss learning problems. Through consultation, possible assistance will be given to you.
policy.course_pol:
本課堂強調多元包容、專業和禮貌。課堂行為應及時、專業、做好準備、有禮貌，並尊重所有人。
本課堂規範包括出席、準時、尊重他人、專心聆聽、適當使用電子設備等。
網路行為也需同樣尊重，且需要保持良好的溝通和正確的信件格式，
保持開放態度，尊重多元意見，以及適當表達自己的觀點。
policy.course_pol_en:
Classroom Protocol and Expected Behavior   

Maintain respectful and considerate interaction in and out of the classroom.
Arrive on time and stay for the duration of class.
Avoid distracting behaviors (talking, sleeping, etc.), and minimize use of devices.
Listen attentively, participate actively, and speak clearly when presenting.
Keep mobile devices silent and put away, and do not wear earphones.
Dress appropriately and maintain cleanliness.
Diversity and Inclusion

Respect and value the diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives of all students.
Foster a respectful and inclusive environment in the classroom.
Course Communication and Netiquette Guidelines

Use o365 mailbox for course-related communication, and be polite and clear in all interactions.
Maintain respectful and considerate behavior online, similar to in-person classroom etiquette.
Participate actively in online activities, and respect others' participation and opinions.
Keep written communication clear, concise, and focused.
Review and proofread all written content before posting.
Avoid excessive use of emojis and caps, slang, and inappropriate content.
Student Responsibilities

Keep your contact information updated in the MyFCU personal information form.
Confirm activation of your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID password.
Understand and comply with the course syllabus, manage your study time well, and regularly check updates.
Adhere to academic integrity, participate actively, and use library resources and copyrighted textbooks responsibly.
Provide feedback through mid-term and final course evaluations.
policy.course_rem:
Every moment in class is precious, and active participation is key to maximizing its value. Here are two pivotal tips for enhancing your learning:

Note-taking: Rather than merely copying, jotting down lectures helps process information, reinforcing understanding. These notes are also beneficial for exam revisions.

Resource Utilization: Take advantage of our provided resources like online courses and learning centers. They are there to help clarify complex topics and offer additional study techniques.

Embrace learning wholeheartedly, and always seek assistance when needed. Together, let's make this journey enriching.
